observations.content: User requested implementing and verifying minimal Rust correctness fix AGNT-0032 in tools/skill-eval for frontier spending, with commit 45821295's concurrent waves allowing paid attempts that fail verification/judging to be stored only as infrastructure events and omitted from reconstructed spend, enabling resume budget reuse and frozen-limit overruns.

Required behavior: persist a fail-closed frozen per-trial reservation charge for each non-quota failed wave outcome; quota outcomes remain uncharged absent durable evidence; old FrontierInfrastructureEvent JSON must deserialize with a default zero charge; include failed charges in authoritative spend reconstruction, validation, save-lag recovery, reports, and scheduling; preserve schema except for the smallest backward-compatible defaulted event field.

User required focused tests for failed reservation charges, resume non-reuse, legacy zero-charge loading, successful actual candidate plus judge costs, and unchanged quota behavior; run cargo fmt and focused tests; avoid Pi/providers/models/network/paid or evaluation commands; modify only needed tools/skill-eval Rust source/tests; commit in isolated worktree and report branch, commit, and exact checks.

Repository research started at detached HEAD 8cff0a9c ('Preserve legacy frontier trial paths.') after reading engineer and rust-style skills, code-style overrides, rust baseline, and .map/invariants.md; relevant invariant requires concurrent test fixtures to use unique filesystem paths.

Current FrontierInfrastructureEvent in tools/skill-eval/src/model.rs has model, artifact, case, attempt, infrastructure_attempt, message, and occurred_at fields, with no charge field; infrastructure failures are appended in commit_frontier_wave in service.rs and immediately persisted.

Current frontier_spend in tools/skill-eval/src/service.rs sums only each TrialRecord candidate_usage and judge_usage costs, and is used by progress updates, authority reconstruction, save-lag validation/recovery, and saved-authority validation; scheduler next_frontier_wave projects state.spent plus wave reservation and therefore also needs failed-event charges reflected in state.

Current scheduler tracks infrastructure events per model/artifact/case/attempt, enforces contiguous attempts and maximum attempts, and schedules retries; event constructors exist in frontier_store.rs, frontier_scheduler.rs, and frontier_report.rs tests and will need updates if a non-optional field is added.
